extract_script = '''\
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

DOCX_PATH = "testbed/docs/customer_report.docx"
WORD_NS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}"

# --- Extract paragraphs ---
with zipfile.ZipFile(DOCX_PATH) as z:
    doc_xml = z.read("word/document.xml")

root = ET.fromstring(doc_xml)
body = root.find(f"{WORD_NS}body")

print("=== PARAGRAPHS ===")
for i, para in enumerate(body.findall(f".//{WORD_NS}p")):
    texts = [node.text for node in para.findall(f".//{WORD_NS}t") if node.text]
    line = "".join(texts).strip()
    if line:
        print(f"[P{i}] {line}")

# --- Extract tables ---
print("\\n=== TABLES ===")
tables = body.findall(f".//{WORD_NS}tbl")
for t_idx, tbl in enumerate(tables):
    print(f"\\n--- Table {t_idx + 1} ---")
    for r_idx, row in enumerate(tbl.findall(f"{WORD_NS}tr")):
        cells = []
        for cell in row.findall(f"{WORD_NS}tc"):
            cell_texts = [n.text for n in cell.findall(f".//{WORD_NS}t") if n.text]
            cells.append("".join(cell_texts).strip())
        print(f"  Row {r_idx}: {cells}")
'''
await write_file("./read_docx_builtin.py", extract_script)
print("Script written successfully.")

docx_output = await run_command("python ./read_docx_builtin.py")
